messages:
sarah.s: FYI — Acme reports their tool call started failing after switching to JSON mode. They see a 401 and runtime error mentioning a missing 'account_id'. Posting the customer's payload + runtime error below.

runtime-bot: [auto] toolcall_reject id=abc123 reason=missing_required_key key=account_id status=401 model=rw-infer-v2

sarah.s: Customer-sent body (as they pasted it):
```json
{
  "input": "{\"tool\":\"charge\",\"args\":{\"amount\":100,\"currency\":\"USD\"}}"
}
```

sarah.s: And runtime error from our logs: 
```
{"error":"tool_call_failed","message":"missing required property 'account_id' at /args","request_id":"abc123","phase":"validation"}
```

devin.k: Copying — looks like the customer's JSON is double-encoded: they put a JSON string in the input field instead of an object. That would make the structured parser see args as missing. Can you grab the raw request headers?

sarah.s: Customer curl they used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"{\"tool\":\"charge\",\"args\":{\"amount\":100,\"currency\":\"USD\"}}"}'
```

devin.k: Yep — double-encoded. In JSON mode we expect the tool call object to be an actual JSON object, not a string. Workaround for them: send the object directly, e.g. 
```json
{"tool":"charge","args":{"account_id":"acct_123","amount":100,"currency":"USD"}}
```

oncall-ops: I'll add a small parser heuristic to detect top-level strings that look like JSON and include a clearer error message suggesting double-encoding. I'll push a patch to the validation layer (small change).

sarah.s: Another customer concern: they were billed for the attempt even though the tool didn't execute. Logs show a billing_event recorded: 
```
{
  "request_id":"abc123",
  "billing_phase":"pre-exec-token-charge",
  "tokens":7
}
```

devin.k: We should not finalize billing before tool execution success. I'll create an internal issue to ensure we only emit final billing events after execution or mark them retriable. Opening INC:INC-2026-045 referencing abc123.

runtime-bot: ticket_created id=INC-2026-045 linked_request=abc123

sarah.s: OK — I'll reply to the customer with: 1) root cause (double-encoded JSON), 2) minimal repro and correct payload example, 3) we opened an internal ticket for billing and will follow up.

devin.k: For support reply, include this snippet to repro quickly: 
```bash
# bad (double-encoded) -> fails validation
curl -X POST ... -d '{"input":"{\"tool\":\"charge\",\"args\":{\"amount\":100}}"}'

# good -> succeeds
curl -X POST ... -d '{"tool":"charge","args":{"account_id":"acct_123","amount":100}}'
```

sarah.s: Perfect. Filing internal notes and will update customer thread with ETA ~24h for billing follow-up. :+1:
